events.name: Airtastic Quiet Sessions (Inflata, soft play & bowling)

events.price: Soft play £8.75–£9.50; Inflata £15.95 (carer free); bowling from £6.95

events.price: Free for person with additional needs + carer

events.description: Quieter daily morning hour.

events.name: Ulster Folk Museum Santa (private visits)
events.description: Private family Santa visits (not SEN-labelled); you have Santa to yourselves. Prefer daytime over evening slots.

events.name: Valley Playzone soft play Quiet Hour
events.description: No music or PA announcements, sensory toys out, quieter time of day. No booking needed.

events.name: Brook Leisure Centre Sensory Swim
events.description: Quiet swim with sensory lights, projections, toys and floats; shallow 0.9m pool floor.

events.name: High Rise Inclusion Zone Soft Play
events.description: Reduced numbers, no music, for autism/sensory needs. Autism NI Impact Award venue with 2 sensory rooms. Book ahead — often sells out. Inclusion Zone Clip 'n Climb runs at the same time (age 4+, £10, shorter briefing, ear defenders to borrow).

events.name: LeisurePlex Disability & ASD Friendly Swim
events.description: 90-minute supervised leisure-pool session for disabled/autistic swimmers and families, with floats and toys. Booking opens 7am, 7 days ahead.

events.name: Ice Bowl Sensory Friendly / Inclusive Ice Skating
events.description: Small sessions for ages 4+ with sensory needs, with height-adjustable skating aids and trained staff. Pre-booking essential (opens 7 days ahead). Next: Fri 30 Oct 3:30–5pm.
events.recurring: 2nd Tuesday & last Friday of each month (next Fri 30 Oct, 3:30–5pm)

events.name: Belfast Zoo (Autism NI Impact Award)
events.description: Visual pre-visit guide by email, ear defenders on loan, fast-track entry with JAM/Autism card; quietest 9–10am and from 2pm in winter. Steep paths.

events.name: Hazelbank Park Sensory Garden
events.description: Free calm sensory garden built for autism and sensory needs: chimes, drums, stepping logs, mirrors, wide paths. Needs a RADAR key.

events.name: V36 inclusive play park
events.description: Flagship council play park with sensory play elements, wheelchair swing and roundabout.

events.name: Mo Mowlam inclusive Play Park
events.description: Free inclusive park with 40+ pieces of equipment and a dedicated multi-sensory area. Official Quiet Hour every Sunday 9:30–10:30am for children with extra needs. Communication boards at both entrances.
events.recurring: Open daily; Quiet Hour every Sunday 9:30–10:30am

events.name: Blacks Road Sensory Playground
events.description: Council sensory playground in west Belfast.

events.name: Antrim Castle Gardens Sensory Garden
events.description: Calming sensory garden in an Autism NI Impact Award venue; pre-visit guides and a sensory tour available.

events.name: Ballyclare Sensory Garden
events.description: Free sensory garden designed for autism and sensory needs, with chimes, drums and touch panels.

events.name: Carnfunnock Country Park (Impact Award)
events.description: Autism NI Impact Award park with a sensory park (textures, musical instruments), quiet hour and pre-visit guide.

events.name: The Gobbins (Impact Award)
events.description: Autism welcome pack, quiet room, advance check-in and noise warnings. Check age/height limits for the cliff path before booking.

events.name: Bangor Aurora sensory room & packs
events.description: Autism NI Impact Award leisure centre; sensory packs (ear defenders, fidgets) and a chill-out sensory room on request; soft play on site.
events.recurring: During opening hours — ask at reception

events.name: Castlewood Pumpkin Dash & Carve Quiet Session
events.description: Quieter pumpkin picking, carving and Halloween crafts for children with additional needs. Pre-booking essential.

events.name: Hilltop Pumpkin Dash & Carve Quiet Session
events.description: Quieter pumpkin picking, carving and crafts for children with additional needs at The Hub. Pre-booking essential.

events.name: Bangor Aurora Quieter Hours
events.description: Centre-wide quieter hours for sensory needs (swim, soft play and facilities). May be busier in school holidays.

events.name: Airtastic Bangor Quiet Soft Play
events.description: Autism-friendly quiet soft play: no music or loud announcements, no strobe/flashing lights, minimum house lights, reduced capacity.

events.name: Movie House CitySide Relaxed Screenings
events.description: Monthly sensory-friendly film: no ads or trailers, lights up a little, sound down, free to move around. Usually first weekend of the month around 11am, marked RS on the listings. No date is listed right now, so check the page.

events.name: 2 Royal Avenue sensory dome & quiet room
events.description: Free city-centre community hub with a sensory dome (light and sound), a quiet room and a cosy play area. Fidget toys and headphones to borrow. Handy break during a trip into town.

events.name: Through the Looking Glass sensory space
events.description: Calm, low-lit sensory play space with bubble tubes, fibre-optic lights and tactile play, for children with sensory needs. Booked sessions only; times and prices on their Facebook page (Through the Looking Glass NI).

events.name: ODEON Belfast Autism Friendly Screenings
events.description: One Sunday morning each month: lights low but on, sound turned down, no adverts or trailers, and it's fine to move around and make noise. Use the 'Autism Friendly Screenings' filter on the ODEON Belfast listings to see the film and date.

events.name: Honeybees Playtown SEN Sessions
events.description: 90-minute SEN sessions at a role-play/soft play town with reduced numbers, lower lighting and quieter music. Dates are announced on their social media; email hello@honeybeesplaytown.co.uk.

events.name: Newry Leisure Centre Autism Swim
events.description: Dedicated swim session for people with autism and their families, run by Newry, Mourne & Down council. Pre-booking recommended via the NMD Be Active app or 0330 137 4026.

events.name: Down Leisure Centre Autism Swim
events.description: Dedicated swim session for people with autism and their families, run by Newry, Mourne & Down council. Pre-booking recommended via the NMD Be Active app or 0330 137 4026.

events.name: Kilkeel Leisure Centre Autism Swim
events.description: Dedicated swim session for people with autism and their families, run by Newry, Mourne & Down council. Pre-booking recommended via the NMD Be Active app or 0330 137 4026.

events.name: Nature and Nurture role-play village & sensory room
events.description: Calm, screen-free wooden-toy role-play village (11 play areas incl. mini market, GP surgery, projection pond) with a sensory room, ages 1–7. Their own site lists no dedicated SEN session (a listings site mentions SEN-friendly sessions), so ask on 07398 109120. Closed Sundays.

events.name: Templemore Baths Foundation SEND swim lessons
events.description: Weekly 30-minute group swimming lessons for children aged 4+ with sensory or learning disabilities, led by an experienced teacher. Join any time. Better's Level Water partnership may fund lessons for some children aged 4–11 with physical/sensory disabilities.

events.name: Amphitheatre Carrickfergus Quiet Time Swim
events.description: Quiet-time public swim on Monday evenings in both the small pool (with slide and water features) and the main pool. Term-time timetable; check with reception 028 9335 8342.

events.name: Joey Dunlop Leisure Centre (Autism NI Impact Award)
events.description: Autism NI Impact Award (Sept 2026): calm packs, pre-visit guides, maps and clearer signs. Pool plus Treasure Island 3-floor soft play (under 12s, £3.90–£4.90). No dedicated SEN session, so phone to ask about quiet times.
events.venue: Joey Dunlop Leisure Centre, 33 Garryduff Road

events.name: Ludo Soft Play Quiet Hour
events.description: Bookable inclusive soft-play hour for children with disabilities or specific needs. Limited numbers, safe-space tent, and sensory/autism packs from reception (£5 refundable deposit). Book via Get MEActive app or Amphitheatre 028 9335 8342.
events.recurring: Every Monday, Wednesday and Friday from 15 Jun 2026
events.venue: Ludo Soft Play, Amphitheatre Leisure Centre
events.price: £3.80 per child / £6.30 for 2 from same family (from 1 Apr 2026); free with Family membership

events.name: Airtastic Bangor Quiet Bowling
events.description: Autism-friendly quiet bowling: no music or loud announcements, no strobe/flashing lights, minimum house lights, reduced capacity. Lights and sound return to normal from 11am.

events.name: Carrickfergus Castle (sensory room)
events.description: Norman castle with a sensory room on the keep ground floor (calm low-light space with sensory tent), confirmed in the official Department for Communities visitor guide and on Mid & East Antrim tourism. Carers free. Third-party guides mention a Sunday 9:30–11am quiet time, but no official DfC, Discover NI or council page lists it (rechecked 16 Oct) — phone 028 9335 1273 or email carrickfergus.castle@communities-ni.gov.uk to confirm before travelling. Winter: Tue–Sun 9am–4pm (Mon closed except bank holidays); last entry 3:30pm.
events.price: Child £4 / Adult £6; under-5s and carers free; family £18

events.name: Sensory Kids NI (soft play & sensory room)
events.description: Antrim charity sensory space designed for children and young people with learning difficulties, developmental disabilities, sensory impairments or autism (ages 2+). Soft-play/sensory room for 1:1 or small groups; phone or email to book. Also listed on Family Support NI.
events.venue: Sensory Kids, Unit 58, The Junction, 111 Ballymena Road

events.name: Mount Stewart (calm/sensory bags)
events.description: National Trust house, gardens and demesne on Strangford Lough. Free calm (sensory) bags to borrow from visitor reception for visitors with additional needs; accessible lake/garden paths; Changing Places toilet; mobility scooters/outdoor wheelchairs bookable. Under-5s free. Natural play area and woodland trails — quieter midweek. House lift currently unavailable. Halloween (24 Oct to 1 Nov): Magic Ink Pot sensory trail in the House 11:00–16:00 (ground floor only, decorated) and Frightful Fernery outdoor trail 10:00–17:00; both free with admission, no booking.
events.price: Child £8 / adult £16 (Gift Aid higher); under-5s free; NT members free

events.name: Castle Espie Wetland Centre (sensory garden)
events.description: WWT wetland centre on Strangford Lough with sensory garden, adventure play and bird hides. Official accessibility page recommends quieter visits Mon–Fri during term time; essential carers free. Flat wide paths (woodland path steep/unpaved); wheelchair/scooter hire for Shop Mobility members.

events.name: The Wee Village Inclusive Play Sessions (additional needs)
events.description: Role-play village and play café running sessions specifically for children with additional needs who need a calmer environment: numbers cut to 12 per session, music off, lower lighting, no strong scents, ear defenders available. 1 adult included per child; complimentary snack. Run throughout the year — contact the venue for the next date or to arrange one.
events.venue: The Wee Village, 29B Deer Park Road
events.price: Standard session price (1 adult included); email hello@theweevillage.co.uk

events.name: Barnardo's Play for All Saturday Clubs
events.description: Inclusive play, art and leisure club for disabled children aged 5–11 (including autism and learning disability), and their siblings. Clubs meet fortnightly on Saturdays, September to June, in Bangor, Downpatrick, Gilnahirk, Hannahstown and Saintfield. Parents can self-refer by phoning 07825 657218.
events.venue: Barnardo's Play for All (Bangor, Downpatrick, Gilnahirk, Hannahstown, Saintfield)

events.name: MPDA Sensory Room (one-to-one / family sessions)
events.description: SpaceKraft sensory room at the Muckamore Parish Development Association hub. Staff trained in sensory play for children with an autism diagnosis (Autism NI Keyhole trained; Autism NI Impact Award) run one-to-one child and parent/carer sessions. Free for registered MPDA users; others can pay to book for one child or a small family group.
events.recurring: Open 6 days a week (book a slot)
events.venue: MPDA Community Hub, 1A Limetree Avenue, Ballycraigy

events.name: Hillsborough Castle and Gardens (autism-aware visit)
events.description: Royal residence and 100-acre gardens. All staff have Autism Awareness Training developed with Autism NI; castle visitor numbers are capped; sensory bags and games available from staff; downloadable pre-visit guides for the castle and gardens. Quietest before 11am; no sound effects on tours, but some rooms have low lighting. Check Gun Salute dates (very loud cannon fire). Carer free.
events.recurring: Gardens open most days; castle Fri–Sun (check calendar)
events.venue: Hillsborough Castle and Gardens, Main Street

events.name: Infinity Adventure Park Inclusion Mission (additional needs trampoline session)
events.description: Trampoline and ninja-obstacle park session designed with additional needs in mind, with lower capacity than open sessions. Soft play area for under-6s on site. Halloween week (27 Oct to 1 Nov) keeps the Thursday 6pm and Sunday noon Inclusion slots. Book online; times can change for private events.
events.recurring: Every Thursday 6–7pm and Sunday 12–1pm (term time and Halloween week)

events.name: Castle Ward (Lough View Quiet Space and calm bags)
events.description: National Trust estate on Strangford Lough. Lough View Quiet Space is an accessible sensory-friendly quiet hut open daily; free calm bags (fidget toys, ear defenders, sensory items) to borrow from reception; indoor play den in the Stableyard (10am–4pm daily, ramp access on request). Shuttle around the estate; sensory packs bookable in advance.
events.price: NT admission applies; NT members free

events.name: Belfast Castle and Cave Hill Visitor Centre (Autism Impact Award venue)
events.description: Staff hold the Autism Impact Award and JAM Card accreditation, so they're trained to give extra time and privacy. Free parking, lift, accessible toilets, self-guided Cave Hill Visitor Centre, adventure playground and gardens. Free entry; quieter on weekday mornings.

events.name: Hill Croft School Play Dates (ages 0–6, additional needs)
events.description: Relaxed play group at Hill Croft special school for local children aged 0–6 with a possible learning difficulty, with their parents/carers. Uses a foundation classroom, safe enclosed playground and soft play; staff give advice and parents meet others in the same position. Themed Halloween and Christmas sessions; Attention Autism and sensory stories later in the year. Open to children not at the school. Contact 028 9083 7488 / info@hillcroftschool.co.uk.

events.name: Ice Bowl Sensory Friendly Xtreme Bowling Hour
events.description: A dedicated Sensory Friendly Hour on the Xtreme (light-and-music) bowling lanes every Saturday lunchtime, before the regular Xtreme session starts at 1pm. Carers can apply for the Ice Bowl buddy card.

events.name: Play Town NI SEN Session
events.description: SEN play session at a new role-play mini-town (shops, café, pretend play) for little ones. Book on Bookwhen; check there for further SEN dates.

events.name: The Storyland sensory play space (quiet times on request)
events.description: Immersive, fully accessible story-themed play space with lots of sensory elements, popular with autistic children. Quiet times are available (phone 028 3025 7885 for details) and one-to-one support from a play/arts therapist can be requested in advance. Open Wed–Sat 10–5 (Tue–Sat in school holidays).
events.venue: Sticky Fingers Arts, The Imaginarium Centre, 10 Upper Edward Street

events.name: Banbridge Leisure Centre sensory pod
events.description: Calming sensory pod with self-selected lighting and music/video; ask reception. Also available at Dromore Leisure Centre. Useful quiet space alongside Get Active ABC quiet swims.

events.name: SNAP North Belfast Autism Family Group (Saturdays)
events.description: Weekly parent-run group for autistic children and their families: children play in a relaxed setting while parents chat over tea. About 10 families each week; also runs trips (e.g. Santa Train). Contact Joe & Jacquie Kelly on 028 9037 0090 before first visit (SENAC lists 10am–12pm, so confirm time).
events.venue: Jennymount Methodist Church, 230 North Queen Street, BT15 3DH

events.name: Blue Blossoms ASD/ADHD Family Support Group (Saturdays)
events.description: Parent-led group for families affected by autism and ADHD: arts, crafts and play time for the children, with tea, coffee and snacks. Message their Facebook page (facebook.com/blueblossomsasdadhdfamilysupportgroup) or call 07736 587429 to join.
events.venue: The Sovereign Complex (Rathfern), Knockenagh Avenue, BT36 6BE

events.name: Helping Hands Autism Resource Centre weekly children's sessions
events.description: Parent-led autism charity running weekly sessions by age group from P1 upwards, in a centre with a sensory zone, role play room, games room and outdoor play area. Primary-age Stay and Play is on Friday evenings (parents stay; booked through Eventbrite, per their Facebook). Self-referral: 028 9620 6286 or 075 4765 6221.
events.venue: Autism Resource Centre, Millars Lane, BT16 2DA

events.name: CAPAA Autism Kids Social Club (Saturdays)
events.description: Parent-run autism social club for children (ages about 3–11) every Saturday afternoon; a bus is available. Call 07999 525323 or message their Facebook page to join and get the venue.

events.name: Lesley Abbeycentre Sensory-Friendly Shopping Hour
events.description: Mall stimulus reduced every Monday 5–6pm (ASD Aware centre). Staff can help; pre-visit guide, activity sheets, audio and video tour on the centre website.

events.name: Victoria Square Quiet Times & Sensory Packs
events.description: ASD Aware centre with dedicated quiet time Wed 9:30–11am (plus quieter slots other days). Free sensory packs (ear defenders, fidget toys, radar key, ICE wristband) from Customer Services (Lower Ground).
events.recurring: Quiet time every Wednesday 9:30–11am; other quieter slots Mon–Sun (see page)
events.price: Free to visit; sensory packs free to hire

events.name: Mo Mowlam Play Park Quiet Hour
events.description: Official Quiet Hour for a calmer visit for children with extra needs at the inclusive Stormont play park (multi-sensory area and communication boards).
events.venue: Mo Mowlam Play Park, Stormont Estate

events.name: Circusful Itty Bitty Circus classes (autism-supported)
events.description: Weekly small circus-skills classes shaped to each child's needs (4–5 yrs Mon/Tue 4–5pm; 6–7 yrs Mon/Tue 5:30–6:30pm). Autism NI Impact Award: autism-trained trainers, visual timetable, pop-up sensory tents, communication passport, and a free orientation visit or video before starting. Register interest online or call 028 9023 6007; tell them about additional needs at enrolment. No classes 20 Oct–2 Nov or 15 Dec–4 Jan.
events.venue: Circusful, 23–25 Gordon Street, Cathedral Quarter, BT1 2LG

events.name: You2Me Play Halloween Camp (additional needs), Marrowbone
events.description: Three-morning Halloween holiday camp from You2Me Play, whose holiday camps are designed for children with additional needs. Messy play and sensory exploration, crafts, baking and pumpkin decorating, games, a Halloween disco, and a calm corner. Book single days (£28) or all three (£75). Read the information pack on the booking page before booking (it covers ages and drop-off), and no refunds within 48 hours.

events.name: You2Me Play Halloween Camp (additional needs), Downpatrick
events.description: Three-morning Halloween holiday camp from You2Me Play, whose holiday camps are designed for children with additional needs. Messy play and sensory exploration, crafts, baking and pumpkin decorating, games, a Halloween disco, and a calm corner. Book single days (£28) or all three (£75). Read the information pack on the booking page before booking (it covers ages and drop-off), and no refunds within 48 hours.
events.venue: Dunsford Old School, 1 Tollumgrange Road, BT30 7SR

events.name: Inclusive GymFun (gymnastics for children with additional needs)
events.description: Semi-structured gymnastics class for primary-aged children with additional needs, run by GymFun at the Ulster University Sports Village, Jordanstown. Coaches use visual strategies in a quiet, calm and relaxed setting, with a high coach-to-child ratio and time to explore the gym at the child's own pace. Parents may be asked to stay. Places are through a waiting list on the club's page.
events.venue: Ulster University Sports Village, Jordanstown, BT37 0QB

events.name: Tilt Gymnastics GymABLE class
events.description: Gymnastics class for children with physical, psychological or social needs. Uses sensory equipment, large visual wall boards and adapted equipment, with skills broken down step by step. Check the class schedule for the current day and time, and use the enquiry form as places are limited.
events.venue: Tilt Gymnastics, Units 5 & 6 Prince Regent Road, Castlereagh, BT5 6QR

events.name: Origin Gymnastics GymABLE (SEN gymnastics, ages 3–12+)
events.description: Fully inclusive gymnastics class designed for children who need extra guidance, structure and care, particularly autistic children and children with Down syndrome. Adapted activities, every child at their own pace. Book at the Newtownbreda (south Belfast) or Newtownards centre through the page; an annual insurance fee applies.

events.name: Bangor Gymnastics Inclusive Open Play (4+)
events.description: Inclusive open-play gymnastics session for children with disabilities aged 4 and up. Pay as you go, booked through the club's ClassForKids portal (bangorgymnasticsclub.classforkids.io). There's also a structured inclusive class on Tuesdays 7–7:45pm for ages 7+.

events.name: SBG Belfast Cheeky Monkeys (martial arts for autistic children, ages 4–6 tier)
events.description: Brazilian jiu-jitsu / movement classes built for children with autism and neurodiversity. Non-striking, games-based, 60 minutes; children can watch until they're ready to join. A detailed timetable is given after a consultation, so email to arrange.
events.venue: SBG Belfast, Joy's Entry, 30 Ann Street, BT1 4DR

events.name: Acting Up Belfast Glengormley Drama (ages 3–6, autism-inclusive)
events.description: Small drama class run by a founder who set up Acting Up for children with additional needs and autistic children. Classes are tailored to each child, with a sensory area, ear defenders, visual timers and calming music. Free trial offered on some classes; book online.
events.recurring: Every Saturday in term (Sep–Oct and 2 Nov–12 Dec 2026 terms)
events.venue: Ballyduff Community Centre, Forthill Drive, BT36 6QS

events.name: Mackenzie Equestrian Inclusive Riding (ASD programmes)
events.description: Riding school with instructors trained to work with autistic children and children with Down syndrome, including Makaton-trained staff. Gentle ponies matched to each rider; lessons tailored to the child. Contact to arrange a programme (tel 07751 928257).

events.name: Special Yoga & ASD Family Yoga at Maitri Studio
events.description: Yoga for children with additional needs including autism, with small group slots, 1:1 and ASD family sessions in a ground-floor, wheelchair-accessible studio. Contact the studio (028 9099 2428) or SHINE special yoga (07789 726696) for current session times.

events.name: Mae Murray Foundation All-Ability Music Session at The Music Yard
events.description: Free all-ability family music session run by the Mae Murray Foundation (a charity for people with disabilities and their families) at The Music Yard, an inclusive music and wellbeing centre. Whole family welcome; parents stay with their child. Changing Places toilet on site. Free but booking essential via the Mae Murray ticket page.
events.venue: The Music Yard, Unit 5 Stylux Business Park, Old Glenarm Road
